name: lego Open-Source ACME Client and DNS-01 Automation
free_limit: MIT-licensed local Go ACME client and library for issuing, renewing and revoking TLS certificates, with DNS-01, HTTP-01 and TLS-ALPN-01 validation and 200+ DNS-provider integrations; no software license fee or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: This is local certificate automation, not a free managed DNS, CDN, hosting or paid certificate authority plan. Requires control of domains and DNS/HTTP validation; domain registration, DNS provider APIs, paid CAs, infrastructure and operational costs may apply. ACME issuer rate limits and provider-specific policies apply.
